value.name: group descends stairs with folder
value.description: Asha, Lucia, and Daniel move down the stairs together, with the folder no longer being argued over.
evidence: By the time they reached the bottom of the stairs the folder was no longer in question between the three of them; only what would be done with it at the table.

value.name: enter sitting room
value.description: The trio enters the sitting room at the front of the house, shifting the scene to the table.
evidence: The sitting room held the cooler light of the front of the house

value.name: Asha indicates Lucia should sit
value.description: Asha pulls out a chair and silently signals Lucia to take a seat.
evidence: Asha drew out the chair at the near side of the table and stood behind it until Lucia understood she was meant to sit.

value.name: Lucia places folder on table
value.description: Lucia ignores the offered chair, places the folder in the center of the table, and steps back from it.
evidence: Instead Lucia walked past the chair to the table's center, set the folder down flat with both hands, and let go in a single motion that pressed the leather corner of the journal audibly against the wood; then she stepped back from it

value.name: Lucia looks to Daniel
value.description: After setting down the folder, Lucia looks toward Daniel, who has stopped in the doorway.
evidence: she stepped back from it and lifted her eyes to the doorway, where Daniel had stopped just inside the threshold.

value.name: Daniel hangs back at threshold
value.description: Daniel remains at the doorway, watching the folder without approaching and losing his earlier softness.
evidence: He did not come any closer.

He stood with his hand resting on the back of the farther chair, watching the folder under Lucia's released palms as if he were measuring the distance between it and himself, the practiced softness gone out of his face and nothing yet arrived to replace it.

value.name: Asha requests folder contents
value.description: Asha breaks the silence and asks Lucia to show what is inside the folder.
evidence: Asha let the quiet hold a moment, then laid her fingers at the edge of the folder and said, without looking up, that she needed Lucia to show her what was inside.

value.name: Asha opens folder
value.description: Asha begins to open the folder, preparing to inspect its contents.
